title: Seeing tall white children in the Indian Springs barracks

tellings.quote: time when I thought that it that I must be short on vitamins when they would come into my barracks at India in Springs and I would get up and I would see the children playing

plain: Between 1965 and 1967, children of tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites are said to have come into the barracks at Indian Springs, Nevada, and played there. Charles Hall, a man who says he served there and lived among these beings, tells Michels he would get up and "see the children playing". At first, he says, he thought he "must be short on vitamins".
